sentences.en: The family went to see an old castle.
sentences.zh: [音乐] [音乐] 这家人去参观了一座古老的城堡。

sentences.en: Most of it had fallen down a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 城堡的大部分早在很久以前就坍塌了。

sentences.en: "It's just a ruin," said Chip.
sentences.zh: “这只是一片废墟。” Chip 说道。

sentences.en: Kipper wanted to climb on the wall, but Dad said, "No, we must look after old ruins," He said.
sentences.zh: [音乐]Kipper 想爬上城墙，但爸爸说：“不行，我们必须爱护古老的遗迹。” 他说。

sentences.en: "Once upon a time, it was a big castle," "I wonder what it was like to live here," said Biff.
sentences.zh: [音乐]“从前，这里是一座大城堡。”

sentences.en: Mum found a good spot for a picnic.
sentences.zh: 妈妈找到一个好的点为了一个野餐。

sentences.en: Floppy saw a rabbit hole.
sentences.zh: Floppy 看到一个兔子洞。

sentences.en: He began to dig in the ground.
sentences.zh: 他开始在地上挖洞。

sentences.en: Chip saw something shining in the dirt, so he picked it up.
sentences.zh: [音乐] Chip 看到有东西在泥土里闪闪发光，于是他捡了起来。

sentences.en: "It's a glass bead," he said.
sentences.zh: 它是一个玻璃珠子， 他说。

sentences.en: "I wonder who lost it?" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: “真想知道是谁弄丢了它。

sentences.en: Chip looked at the bead through his magnifying glass.
sentences.zh: [音乐] Chip 用放大镜观察这颗珠子。

sentences.en: Then, he put it in his pocket.
sentences.zh: 然后他把它放进了口袋里。

sentences.en: "I don't think it's valuable," he said.
sentences.zh: 我不想它是很值钱的， 他说。

sentences.en: Later, Chip came into Biff's room.
sentences.zh: 后来，Chip 走进了 Biff 的房间。

sentences.en: He had a book about castles.
sentences.zh: 他带了一本关于城堡的书。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然，魔法钥匙开始发光。

sentences.en: The magic took Biff and Chip back in time.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿 Biff 和 Chip 回来在……里时间。

sentences.en: It took them to the castle.
sentences.zh: 它把他们带到了城堡。

sentences.en: Some people were waiting outside a big door.
sentences.zh: 一些人在一扇大门外等着。

sentences.en: An important man came up.
sentences.zh: 一个重要的男人来向上。

sentences.en: "I am Lord Kent," Said the man.
sentences.zh: “我是肯特勋爵。” 那人说道。

sentences.en: "Where is your present for the prince?"
sentences.zh: “你们给王子的礼物在哪里？”

sentences.en: Biff and Chip didn't have a present.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 没有礼物。

sentences.en: "Think of something, Chip," said Biff.
sentences.zh: “想点什么办法吧，Chip？” Biff 说道。

sentences.en: "Uh, we have a magic glass," Said Chip.
sentences.zh: “我们有一面神奇的镜子。” Chip 说道。

sentences.en: "It makes small things look big."
sentences.zh: “它能让小东西看起来变大。”

sentences.en: "That is a good present," said Lord Kent.
sentences.zh: 那个是一个好的礼物， 说君主 Kent。 肯特勋爵说道。

sentences.en: "The prince will like it.
sentences.zh: “王子会喜欢的。”

sentences.en: "Put it on this cushion, then wait outside in the line."
sentences.zh: 把它放在这个垫子上，然后在外面排队等候。

sentences.en: At last, Biff and Chip went into a hall.
sentences.zh: [音乐] 最后，Biff 和 Chip 走进了一间大厅。

sentences.en: "That was quick thinking, Chip," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: “Chip，你刚才想得真周到。” Biff 说道。

sentences.en: "I wonder who this prince is."
sentences.zh: “我真想知道这位王子是谁？”

sentences.en: "He must be important," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 他必须是重要的， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: The prince was sitting on a throne.
sentences.zh: 王子正坐在王座上。

sentences.en: Chip gave him the magnifying glass.
sentences.zh: Chip 把放大镜递给了他。

sentences.en: "I love it!" Said the prince.
sentences.zh: “我喜欢它。” 王子说道。

sentences.en: The prince jumped off the throne and looked through the magnifying glass.
sentences.zh: 王子从王座上跳下来，透过放大镜看了一眼。

sentences.en: "Tomorrow is an important day," He said.
sentences.zh: “明天是个重要的日子。” 他说。

sentences.en: "Tomorrow I will be king."
sentences.zh: “明天我将成为国王。”

sentences.en: You can call me Henry, but tomorrow I will be King Henry," He said.
sentences.zh: “你可以叫我亨利，但明天我就是亨利国王。” 他说。

sentences.en: "Come with me."
sentences.zh: 他说：“跟我来。”

sentences.en: He ran out of the hall.
sentences.zh: 他跑出了大厅。

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: 他说。

sentences.en: "I want to look at it through this magic glass."
sentences.zh: “我想通过这面魔法镜子看看它。”

sentences.en: Henry ran up some stairs.
sentences.zh: 亨利跑上楼梯。

sentences.en: "Come and see my crown," he said.
sentences.zh: 来和看见我的王冠， 他说。

sentences.en: Two guards looked at Biff and Chip.
sentences.zh: 两名卫兵看着 Biff 和 Chip。

sentences.en: "We are here to see that the crown is not stolen," Said a soldier.
sentences.zh: “我们来这里是为了确保王冠不被偷走，” 一名士兵说道。

sentences.en: "Hold your arms up.
sentences.zh: 拿着你的玻璃。 武器向上。

sentences.en: We must search you."
sentences.zh: 我们必须搜寻你。

sentences.en: Henry took Biff and Chip into a small room in a tower.
sentences.zh: 亨利带着 Biff 和 Chip 走进塔楼里的一间小房间。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip gasped when they saw the crown.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 看到王冠时都惊呼了一声。

sentences.en: "It looks very valuable," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 它看非常很值钱的， 说 Chip。 Chip 说道。

sentences.en: "If it was stolen, I could not become king," Said Henry, "but it is safe in this tower.
sentences.zh: “如果它被偷了，我就不能当国王了。”

sentences.en: Nobody could take it from here."
sentences.zh: 没有人能从这里把它拿走。”

sentences.en: "I shall ride him when I become king tomorrow," Lord Kent ran up to Henry.
sentences.zh: “明天我当上国王后，就要骑着它。”

sentences.en: Henry took Biff and Chip to see his horse.
sentences.zh: 亨利带着 Biff 和 Chip 去看他的马。

sentences.en: Tomorrow," he said.
sentences.zh: 来在……上， 他说。

sentences.en: Suddenly, they heard shouting.
sentences.zh: 突然，他们听到了喊叫声。

sentences.en: "Come quickly!" He shouted.
sentences.zh: “快来，” 他大喊道。

sentences.en: "Your crown has been stolen."
sentences.zh: “您的王冠被偷了。”

sentences.en: Henry ran back up the stairs to the crown room.
sentences.zh: 亨利跑回楼上，来到王冠室。

sentences.en: The guards were still outside the door.
sentences.zh: 卫兵仍站在门外。

sentences.en: "The crown is missing," Said a guard.
sentences.zh: “王冠不见了，” 一名卫兵说道。

sentences.en: "How can it be missing?" Asked Henry.
sentences.zh: “怎么会不见了呢？” 亨利问道。

sentences.en: "We don't know," Said a guard.
sentences.zh: “我们不知道。

sentences.en: Has been here, except you."
sentences.zh: “除了你，没有人来过这里。”

sentences.en: "I know who stole it," said Lord Kent.
sentences.zh: 我知道谁 stole 它， 说君主 Kent。 肯特勋爵说道。

sentences.en: "These children have stolen it," Lord Kent went on.
sentences.zh: “是这些孩子偷的，”

sentences.en: "They used magic to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们用魔法偷的。

sentences.en: "Oh," Said Biff, "now we're in trouble."
sentences.zh: “哎呀！”

sentences.en: Throw them in prison at once."
sentences.zh: “马上把他们关进监狱。”

sentences.en: Now read Part 2...
sentences.zh: 现在，请阅读第二部分。
